items.title: Tom Lellis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 31, 2007
items.q: And there was just a brilliant Bill Moyers Journal two weeks ago that these two opposites were on the air with Bill Moyers saying that for the benefit of this country we need to impeach this man.

ctx.x: Do you think we can repair it? How? How can we repair it?

I think for the benefit of the country, this man above all, needs to be impeached. I wrote an article that was actually printed — or a letter that was printed in the Long Island, (New York) Newsday and it was about crying wolf. The impeachment of Clinton was a terrible thing. It shouldn’t have happened for an affair between two people. No one other than them. But the result of that was that everyone is now afraid to impeach the actual wolf. Because this guy is the wolf and he’s in the White House. And now…
Including the late sixties when everything was in such turmoil?
